scope: Exact actual Human deformed >65%-owned digit/palm vertices plus >50% whole-hand mixed-web vertices against all 88 actual animated key inner boxes. Inner margins 2 mm black / 1.4 mm white, original-box nearest-face depth, >3 mm unchanged failure gate. No finger-pair, pad-ray, 240 Hz, continuous-time or visual approval is performed.
broadPhase: Conservative 10 mm world-X bins containing each key inner AABB over inclusive floor(minX/width)..floor(maxX/width). Original world-AABB, inverse-key local-box and nearest-original-face depth tests follow unchanged. At any point inside an original world AABB, its X bin is in that inclusive range.
selection: Every frame i/60 from zero through floor(duration*60), plus the exact score endpoint.
